plain: The splitting of a country or thing into separate parts

webster.text: The act of dividing, or state of being divided.

more.text: Separate part; as lodged in a small partition.
That by which different parts are separated; as a partition of wood or stone in a building.
Division of an estate into severalty, which is done by deed of partition.

example.quote: Not less arduous must have been the task of marking the proper line of partition between the authority of the general and that of the State governments.
